description: Cancel a running async job (verify / preview / brand-kit-extract) returned by an enqueue call — abort a mis-priced job instead of waiting out its TTL. For box-backed jobs the warm box is reaped best-effort; cancel never meters. No-op-reject (422) if already terminal.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

name: cancel_job
title: Cancel Job
